fixer.summary: Burning Hands (Cone) and Thunderwave (Cube) now take every living creature in the area from the scene (game.creatures), using shape and size from SPELLS[...]["area"], the caster as origin, and a direction (point=, or the first named creature other than the caster). The caller's list only aims the area: it can't add a creature outside or leave out one inside (R-16). Thunderwave's Cube was a 15-ft radius around the caster; it is now a real Cube set against one face of the caster's space, via the new geometry.in_cube_from. A cast with no usable direction is refused before anything is paid (SPELL.casting-spells.effects.targets#4, p.106). A named creature outside the area is logged with page=106 and ruling R-16. Behind-Total-Cover creatures are still excluded (GLOSS.area-of-effect). The 'aim at the first named creature' fallback is kept only as a way to state the direction, because 7 acceptance tests cast without point= (see test_change_request). Full suite (818), ruff check/format and dev-gate pass.
srd_tags: SRD[SPELL.casting-spells.effects.targets#4] (area aim check: the area needs a direction)
SRD[SPELL.casting-spells.effects.targets#4] (_area_targets: the area, not the caller's list, decides who is hit)
fixer.test_change_request: To drop the 'aim at the first named creature' fallback entirely (so that only an explicit point= gives a Cone/Cube its direction), these acceptance tests must pass point= because they currently cast Burning Hands or Thunderwave with only a creature list: tests/srd/test_playing_the_game.py (mialee_burns helper -> point=(15, 0); test_cover_doesnt_help_other_saves thunderwave -> point=(20, 0); test_total_cover_doesnt_refuse_an_area_spell -> point=(15, 0)), tests/srd/test_spells.py (test_a_named_creature_outside_the_cone_isnt_affected -> point=(30, 0); test_one_cone_cant_reach_both_sides_of_the_caster -> point=(15, 0) or (-15, 0)), tests/scenarios/test_spells.py::test_spl05_burning_hands -> point=(15, 0), tests/scenarios/test_combat.py CMB-05 Burning Hands casts -> point=(215, 200). After that change, _area_aim would return only the point, and _area_aim_check would refuse a cast without one. The scene-based selection the ticket asks for is already in place and doesn't depend on this change.
